persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Draw a square cartoon of a little yellow robot with one big round eye and purple boots, holding a red watering can beside a pot of seedlings.
bank.Source picture: The robot cartoon made in the first turn.
bank.Subject identity: Keep the same little yellow robot, with one big round eye and purple boots; do not redesign it.
bank.Style: Use the same cartoon drawing style as the generated picture.
bank.Action: The robot tips its red watering can and pours water onto the seedlings in the pot.

messages.text: Could you draw a cartoon for me? I’ve had this little scene in my head for a while, and I’d love to see it brought to life. The character should be a little yellow robot, and the picture should be square. It should have one big round eye and purple boots. Please show it holding a red watering can beside a pot of seedlings.
